# E0418: a condition refers to a name a lens does not define

A lacuna's `when` refers to the lens's source instance and to CUE's builtins,
and to nothing else. A bare name that is neither is undefined.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		b: 0
	}
	lacunas: {
		b: [{
			type:    Placeholder
			message: "0 is a placeholder"
			when:    threshold > 1
		}]
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0418]: threshold is not defined in a lens; an expression refers to v0_0, to len, quo, rem, div, mod and to the strings functions
  --> history/1.0.thema:15:13
   |
15 |             when:    threshold > 1
   |                      ^^^^^^^^^
   |
```
